headline: Public hearings on projects at 205 St. James Avenue, 33 Madison Avenue, 77 Maple Street, and five other addresses.
summary: Continued hearings cover a front door, a heat pump, and exterior repairs at 77 Maple Street. New hearings include roof vents, signs, and two properties with violations.
